answer:
All 8 datasets sit at the root of `/home/hyoklee/cae_test_data/porotomo/dasv_native_PoroTomo_iDAS025_160318160317.h5` (no groups, nothing nested):

| Dataset | Shape | Dtype |
|---|---|---|
| `/das` | (30000, 384) | float32 |
| `/t` | (30000,) | float64 |
| `/trace` | (30000,) | int64 |
| `/channel` | (384,) | int32 |
| `/x` | (384,) | float32 |
| `/y` | (384,) | float32 |
| `/z` | (384,) | float32 |
| `/crs` | () scalar | uint8 |

So the main array is `/das` — 30,000 time samples × 384 channels of strain-rate data — with `/t` and `/trace` as the 30,000-sample time/trace index, the per-channel geometry in `/x`, `/y`, `/z` (384 entries each, matching the channel axis), `/channel` as the 384 channel IDs, and `/crs` as a scalar flag. Shapes and dtypes were read directly from the file via `hdf5_analyze_dataset_structure`; the file was opened read-only and closed afterward.
